description: Server invites are named invite links for partner or related servers, saved into Wynem. Instead of hunting for links in pinned messages, any member can pull up an invite by name, or view the whole list, whenever they need it.

reply.name: Ewan
reply.message: e!serverinvite blockbenchused /server invites

description: A server can save up to `15` server invites. Adding and removing them requires the **Manage Server** permission, but viewing them is available to everyone.

tabs.name: Adding server invites
content:
To add a server invite, use the <command:addserverinvite [invite] [name]|serverconfig serverinvite add invite:[invite] name:[name]> command. You need the **Manage Server** permission to use it.

The invite must be a working Discord invite link (Wynem checks it), and the name can be up to 24 characters long. Names are stored in lowercase with spaces removed, and displayed in title case.
For example: <command:addserverinvite https://discord.gg/blockbench Blockbench|serverconfig serverinvite add invite:https://discord.gg/blockbench name:Blockbench>

reply.name: Ewan
reply.message: e!addserverinvite https://discord.gg/blockbench Blockbenchused /serverconfig serverinvite add

data.title: Server invite added
data.description: The server invite `Blockbench` https://discord.gg/blockbench has been added to the server

content:
The server invite has been added and is ready for your members to use.

Each name and each link can only be saved once, and if the link is not a Discord invite link, it will be rejected:

author: Error
/assets/images/icons/error.webp
data.title: Invalid Discord invite link
data.description: The link `https://ewanhowell.com` is not a valid Discord invite link

tabs.name: Viewing server invites
content: Anyone can view the server invites using the <command:serverinvite [name]|server invites name:[name]> command. Provide no name to view a list of every saved server invite.

reply.name: Ewan
reply.message: e!serverinviteused /server invites

content: To get a specific server invite, provide its name:

reply.name: Ewan
reply.message: e!serverinvite blockbenchused /server invites

content: Wynem sends the resolved invite link, ready to click or share. If the name is not an exact match, the closest matching server invite is used instead. If nothing matches, you will get an error:

author: Error
/assets/images/icons/error.webp
data.title: Server invite not found
data.description: The server invite `Hypixel` was not found in this server

tabs.name: Removing server invites
content: To remove a server invite, use the <command:removeserverinvite [name]|serverconfig serverinvite remove name:[name]> command. You need the **Manage Server** permission to use it.
For example: <command:removeserverinvite blockbench|serverconfig serverinvite remove name:blockbench>

reply.name: Ewan
reply.message: e!removeserverinvite blockbenchused /serverconfig serverinvite remove

data.title: Server invite removed
data.description: The server invite `Blockbench` https://discord.gg/blockbench has been removed from the server

content: The server invite has been removed and can no longer be viewed by members.
